environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4) in a public subnet. The NLB forwards TCP traffic directly to the application on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer filtering or inspection is configured. The application serves the corporate user directory for an internal tool but is exposed publicly for remote workers.
